finding.text: `Server/doc/scripts.md` contradicts itself (req 3, content 1). The summary line changed "**misnamed 26**" to "**live 26** (a function bag or lowercase class…)", so the file now has two "live" counts. The heading says "**0 live remain**" where it means 0 misnamed. The table still marks `Collab.mjs` and `Decide.mjs` as `misnamed`, and all four rows keep the note "Function bag … that should be a class". The fix: misnamed 0, the four rows `live` with a "class since batch 5" note, and the heading "0 misnamed remain, 2 planned".

Requirement 2 asks for "a `decision` line [that] says it waits on the owner", and there isn't one. `grep -c decision task.jsonl` gives 0, and no `.jsonl` under the run directory mentions class-plan. Write the line with `node Server/Decide.mjs` (`--owner-only`).

The fence said "Servex files untouched beyond the doc", but the diff edits path lines in `Servex/Servex.js` (an import), `Lifecycle.js`, `agents/Echo.js` (a dynamic import), `Sessions.js`, `tidy.js` and `ext/`. Windows makes this unavoidable: `browser.mjs` and `Browser.mjs` are the same file there, so no lowercase shim can exist, and `scripts.md` says so. The changes are only path text, and the new `Servex.js` import needs the Servex restart from req 3.

Only `ask-each.mjs` became a one-line shim. `browser.mjs`, `collab.mjs` and `decide.mjs` were deleted, with the reason given in `scripts.md` (the Windows note). On Linux and on GitHub, any import of the lowercase names outside the repo now breaks.
The diff can't prove the requirement-1 checks: `node --check`, tests green, hooks dry-run, undo on a worktree copy. `task.jsonl` should hold a line for each before merge.
